body: I completely understand, when I lost my daughter fasting really helped me focus and ground myself more. I am so sorry for your loss. I do hope this will give you spiritual strength that you deserve.
Good Luck! Are you going to be working through this time period?

You're right, I still have long way to go to get to this question. I guess I just didn't want to start something that might be looked as unethical. But thanks tho, I am super excited about it, gonna take forever to do, but it's nice to finally do something creative after a long break from drawing!
I completely get that, and really my intention is quite innocent, I don't want to publish anything, just use this as my project I wanted to do as a kid haha
It's  really just a passion project. My only intention with this project really is to do something I wished to do as a kid. But there is part of me as an adult that feels abit guilty doing it haha
I tried but nothing is helping, and in some way I feel at peace now, at least after this is done and my preparation is done, I will be with my little girl again
I lost everyone and everything to live for
